definitions.gloss: advisor; counselor; person who gives advice
definitions.explanation: A person who provides guidance, suggestions, or recommendations. Used in both formal institutional settings and general contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信頼|しんらい}できる→信頼する：22988_shinraisuru⟧{助言者|じょげんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦{起業家|きぎょうか}→起業家：14262_kigyouka⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{良|よ}き→良い：02350_yoi⟧{助言者|じょげんしゃ}だった。
examples.english: He was a good advisor to the young entrepreneur.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{助言者|じょげんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}いて→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to invite an external advisor to review the management strategy.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{助言|じょげん}→助言：05461_jogen⟧ (advice) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). A relatively formal word for someone in an advisory role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧{助言者|じょげんしゃ}: external advisor
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧{助言者|じょげんしゃ}: legal advisor
- ⟦{良|よ}き→良い：02350_yoi⟧{助言者|じょげんしゃ}: good advisor
- {助言者|じょげんしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: in the capacity of advisor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アドバイザー: advisor (loanword) — more common in business and casual contexts
- ⟦{顧問|こもん}→顧問：16146_komon⟧: consultant; advisor — typically a formal, sometimes honorary position in organizations
- ⟦{相談役|そうだんやく}→相談役：20958_soudanyaku⟧: consultant; senior advisor — often a post-retirement advisory position in Japanese companies
- カウンセラー: counselor — typically for personal, psychological, or career guidance
